_readme: Hand corrections applied by export_json after all poll feeds are merged, in order. Each rule matches on race (subject), a spelling-tolerant pollster key, and optionally field end date (±tolerance_days). Actions: drop, relabel (new pollster name), set_toplines (dem/rep pct). Source: senate_polls_excluded.csv (Nov 2, 2026). Every applied rule is logged; rules that match nothing are logged as no-ops.
